items.title: Smashing Security podcast #485: These researchers got drunk to hack an LG TV

An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute high-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 8.2. The following CVEs are assigned: C

items.title: ZDI-26-693: Linux Kernel ksmbd Share Configuration Race Condition Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.sum: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Linux Kernel. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. Furthermore, only systems with ksmbd enabled are vulnerable. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 8.5.

items.title: ZDI-26-692: Linux Kernel eMPIA USB Device Driver Race Condition Code Execution Vulnerability
items.sum: This vulnerability allows physically present attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Linux Kernel. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.1. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-31583.

items.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
items.sum: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.

items.title: Chess.com (2026) - 4,653,212 breached accounts
items.sum: In August 2026, millions of records allegedly sourced from Chess.com were posted online . The data contained 7.3M rows with 4.6M unique email addresses, along with usernames, names, countries and data relating to users' Chess.com accounts.
